" REQ: LANG-531 LANG-532 LANG-533 LANG-534
set nocompatible
let g:demo_enabled = 1

function! s:Greet(name) abort
  " Greets the name.
  let l:text = "Hello, " . a:name . "!\n"
  let l:quoted = 'it''s'
  if exists('g:demo_enabled') && &number
    echo l:text
  elseif len(a:name) > 0 | echom "short" | endif
  return l:text
endfunction

augroup demo
  autocmd!
  autocmd BufWritePre *.go call s:Greet(expand('%'))
augroup END

nnoremap <leader>g :call s:Greet($USER)<CR>
let @a = 'register'
call demo#util#Init(v:true)
